cover_letter.greeting: Dear NY Green Bank Strategy, Impact and Communications Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Associate - Impact role on NY Green Bank's Strategy, Impact and Communications team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. NY Green Bank uses public capital to pull private money into clean energy, and measuring whether that is actually working is the part I want to be close to.

For an MBA project I built project- and portfolio-level models for a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio, looking at DSCR, NPV and levered IRR under post-ITC scenarios, and compared senior debt, sustainability-linked loan and green loan plus ABS structures. At Lenovo I spent two years building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and worked on AI powered dashboards that pulled metrics and projections together for leadership.

The role combines portfolio analysis, impact modeling and regular metrics reporting for senior management and the public. That mix of numbers and clear reporting is what I've done most, in Excel and Tableau, across teams with different priorities. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team before the December 1 deadline.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for NY Green Bank's Associate - Impact role on the Strategy, Impact and Communications team.
